status: pre-registered before creating or observing the train-only holdout results
hypothesis: sampling closed-loop horizons across local, medium and long ranges preserves the T1/T2 gains of 10-step training while directly constraining T3-like long rollout
evidence_boundary: MISATO-100 train-only 12D invariant-feature mechanism proxy; not atomic Geo/Phys/Dyn/Stab and not an official score

split.source: MISATO-100 official training subset only (80 complexes)
split.limitation: not yet protein-homology or ligand-scaffold grouped
split.official_validation_access: prohibited for training, selection and tuning

training.checkpoint_policy: final epoch; no holdout epoch selection
training.horizon_sampling: one horizon uniformly sampled per batch update
training.prefix_length_sampling: uniform valid integer conditional on sampled horizon

comparison: paired one-step Transformer trained from scratch on the same 64/16 split with identical architecture, budget, seeds and final-epoch policy

promotion.primary: mean equal-macro T1/T2/T3 RMSE below paired one-step reference
promotion.seed_consistency: beat paired reference in at least 2 of 3 seeds
promotion.T1_guard: mean T1 RMSE must not worsen by more than 2 percent
promotion.T3_mechanism: mean T3 RMSE must improve by at least 5 percent

next_access_rule: only a complete pass permits one frozen evaluation on the official validation; a failure remains train-only and is not tuned on official validation
